prompt:
Character design painted BY HAND on a wood panel — matte paint, visible brush texture and panel grain in the black, FLAT painting with no 3D shading, no drop shadows, no rendering. Pale bone-grey ground with generous empty space; the creature is SMALL in the frame.
EXACT PROPORTIONS, follow strictly: the figure is SLIGHTLY TALLER THAN IT IS WIDE. The head is only about 40 percent of the total height and is NOT oversized. The body is a PEAR shape that WIDENS TOWARD THE BASE so THE WEIGHT SITS LOW and the creature reads as planted and solid. Head merges into body with no neck. The ears are SMALL — roughly one fifth the width of the head. The eyes are two SMALL GLOWING GREEN DOTS set wide apart and high on the face; there is NOTHING else on the face — no nose, no muzzle, no mouth. Three small green tally marks on the chest. Arms are tiny nubs barely separated from the body; feet are tiny and short so the body almost reaches the ground. Solid black.
NOT chibi. NOT baby-proportioned. NOT a big-headed mascot. Cute through weight and stance, not through an oversized head. No text, no lettering. A row of five of this creature, evenly spaced and small in a wide frame, all standing facing forward with IDENTICAL bodies and proportions, differing ONLY in the small ears: small round ears; long soft upright ears; small pointed ears; wide round ears; small folded-over ears. One family, one body, one weight.
policy: internal concept art only — never the shipped public face
